To behave, act. (The meanings of या, like those of गम्, are
 variously modified according to the noun with which it is connected; e. g.
 नीशं या to be destroyed; वाच्यतां या to incur blame or censure;

 या to reach the other side of, to master, surmount, get over; पदं

 lead, lead; अधो या to sink; विपर्यासं या to undergo a change,
